notes: §1985:VI.4.4.2 prints OBJECT-COMPUTER. then one bracket holding computer-name, an optional MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES}, an optional "PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1" and the second period; §1985:VI.4.4.4 GR5 makes the named alphabet the program collating sequence. objectComputerParagraph/memorySizeClause/programCollatingSequenceClause parse that shape, and at 85 VersionConformancePass.VisitObjectComputerParagraph refuses a clause with no computer-name (COBOL0900), GateLonePeriod (ParagraphPeriods.LonePeriod) refuses the second period with no entry (the gap a prior read found is now closed, kb/Work PB5170), VisitProgramCollatingSequenceClause refuses alphabet-name-2 and FOR forms, ClosedFormatPass refuses a repeated clause (COBOL2423), SEQUENCE before MEMORY (COBOL2987) and a missing final period (COBOL3408), and ResolveProgramCollating binds the alphabet. Probed at --std 85 (classes b, c, d, f): header alone, name alone, name+MEMORY SIZE 10 MODULES, MEMORY 10 CHARACTERS and SEQUENCE REV-SEQ with optional words omitted all compile and the reverse alphabet makes "A" > "B" true; refused: MEMORY or COLLATING without name (0900), 'OBJECT-COMPUTER. .' (0900), name without period (3408), MEMORY twice and SEQUENCE twice (2423), MEMORY after SEQUENCE (2987), MEMORY SIZE 0 (2386), -10 and 1.5 (5506), 18 nines (2427 implementation limit), a missing unit, two units, CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and FOR ALPHANUMERIC (0900), two alphabet-names, an undeclared alphabet (5989). Classes a and e do not reach a paragraph of the Environment Division. The witness writes name, MEMORY SIZE 4096 WORDS and a reversed PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE and displays A AFTER B. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5170 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-07.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-07-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: OBJECT-COMPUTER. [ computer-name [MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES}] [PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1] . ]: the clauses need computer-name. §2023:12.3.6.2 writes [ computer-name-1 ] and the CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE clauses (with FOR ALPHANUMERIC / FOR NATIONAL) as independent options, and has no MEMORY SIZE clause; §2023:12.3.6.3 SR4: "If neither computer-name-1 nor any of the optional clauses is specified, the second period in the General format may be omitted." A 1985 program with MEMORY SIZE is refused; clauses without computer-name are newly accepted. Compile-time only.
